lessons.title: Volume Fundamentals
lessons.description: Understand what volume measures, separate participation from direction, and read price progress together with trading activity.

lessons.title: Price and Volume Relationships
lessons.description: Interpret the four basic combinations of price direction and changing participation.

lessons.title: Relative Volume and Volume Spikes
lessons.description: Normalize current volume against a baseline and distinguish participation expansion from climax or absorption.

lessons.title: Volume Confirmation
lessons.description: Evaluate whether volume supports a breakout, continuation, rejection, or failed move.

lessons.title: On-Balance Volume
lessons.description: Use On-Balance Volume to accumulate volume by closing direction and compare its trend with price.

lessons.title: Accumulation/Distribution and Chaikin Money Flow
lessons.description: Measure where price closes inside each bar’s range and weight that location by volume.

lessons.title: Volume-Weighted Average Price
lessons.description: Calculate session VWAP and use price location around it to describe accepted value and directional control.

lessons.title: Anchored Volume-Weighted Average Price
lessons.description: Start VWAP from a selected event and evaluate whether price is accepted above or below the event’s average traded value.

lessons.title: Volume Profile
lessons.description: Organize traded volume by price rather than time and identify where the market spent activity.

lessons.title: Value Area, POC, HVN, and LVN
lessons.description: Interpret value-area boundaries, high-volume nodes, and low-volume nodes as auction locations.

lessons.title: Bid, Ask, Spread, and Order Types
lessons.description: Understand quoted prices, resting liquidity, marketable orders, and execution trade-offs.

lessons.title: Time and Sales
lessons.description: Read the transaction stream by price, size, side classification, pace, and price response.

lessons.title: Footprint Charts and Bid-Ask Delta
lessons.description: Compare executed volume at the bid and ask within each price level and candle.

lessons.title: Cumulative Volume Delta
lessons.description: Accumulate bid-ask delta through time and compare aggressive flow with price structure.

lessons.title: Order Book and Market Depth
lessons.description: Inspect resting liquidity, queue changes, spread, depth, and the difference between displayed intent and executed trades.

lessons.title: Volume and Order Flow Trading Rules
lessons.description: Convert market context, participation, aggressive flow, and price confirmation into explicit testable rules.
